title: Nice set; no heat rating on utensils; handles too thick for slots; FORC label is upside down on mat
text:
Nice set; no heat rating on utensils; handles too thick for slots; FORC label is upside down on mat. This set comes with a mat that has an embedded spoon rest and slots for holding five utensils. There are also three utensils included--a locking silicone/stainless steel tong and regular and slotted spoons with silicone tips and wooden handles. The handles are a bit too thick to fit in the slots on the mat. Also, there is no heat rating written anywhere for the utensils; therefore, I have no idea if they will melt at certain temperatures. This is a big negative to me. I wrote them to find out the heat rating but have not heard back yet.

Second, the placement of the FORC label on the mat is upside down in the upper right corner--see PHOTO. This is sort of a non-issue but it is a detail that should be corrected.

The mat has a small lip around the edge that will keep water or liquids from running over the sides, which is great.

I love the color of this mat and its versatility. It is certainly very functional. It does come with a 12-month warranty and the label says this is 100% BPA free.

I have no idea how much this will be priced at but anything more than $12 in its current state would be overpriced in my opinion. They are selling similar sets at around $7 such as Amazon product ID #B08P7KD5XW, which is another one of their sets. If this set had handles that fit in the slots on the mat, had a label that was not upside down, and had a heat rating of 450 degrees or higher, then this would have received 5 stars from me.
